purpose: Whole-repo quality audit: bugs, security holes, what breaks under real load, risky code without tests, slow paths, and what to delete, merge or split. Ranked findings, each with the smallest fix. One-shot report, changes nothing.
use_when: Auditing a whole repo or package for bugs, bloat, and risk, ranked by what to fix first
Asking what can be deleted, merged, or split across the codebase
Inheriting a codebase and needing the senior-dev once-over
do_not_use_when: Reviewing one change or diff rather than the whole repo (use ponytail-review)
Standards or spec conformance checks (use code-review)
scope: Reads broadly, changes nothing; one-shot ranked report.
disambiguator: Whole-repo audit and bloat hunt -> this. One diff/PR -> ponytail-review. Implementing with least code -> ponytail.
